notes:
{悟|さと}り is the noun form of the verb ⟦{悟|さと}る→悟る：12601_satoru⟧ (to realize, to understand). In Buddhist contexts, it refers to spiritual awakening or enlightenment.

Key expressions:
- {悟|さと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to attain enlightenment)
- {悟|さと}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}る→至る：02009_itaru⟧ (to reach enlightenment)
- {悟|さと}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{境地|きょうち}→境地：12121_kyouchi⟧ (state of enlightenment)

In everyday usage, {悟|さと}り can also refer to a profound realization or acceptance of truth about life.
